recipes.name: ADAS · native MGSM gateway pilot v1
setup: Use the exact ADAS source pin, a separate Python3.11 environment with openai1.90.0, numpy2.2.6, backoff2.2.1 and tqdm4.67.1, and the reviewed official MGSM four-example dataset.
Plan-only preparation never runs native code. Explicit execution uses the native seven-strategy initial archive, one meta-search generation and unchanged generated-agent forward/scorer.

profiles.description: Tiny official MGSM native meta-search pilot with separate underlying optimization and heldout problems; not a paper reproduction.

evaluation.description: Calls pinned evaluate_forward_fn and score_mgsm. All seven native initial strategies and one native meta-search generation use two optimization examples. Only one selected archived code hash receives two heldout examples after selection freezes.

argument_help: --model must be one of the seven exact gateway IDs; both meta and inner agents bind that same ID. Supply inputs arena-inputs/mgsm-adas-pilot-v1.json with the reviewed immutable dataset.
limitations: Two optimization and two heldout examples are a small integration check, not evidence of benchmark superiority or paper reproduction. MGSM parallel translations are split by underlying source row identity.

Native search, initial archive, reflection prompts, JSON parsing and native exact-string scoring remain in upstream code. The prompt utility model default reflects the explicitly selected model. No model alias is substituted.

Provider failures abort with unknown outcome rather than becoming fitness zero or entering unbounded native rate-limit retries. SDK timeout330, retries0; requested temperature/max_tokens/stop are not guaranteed by the separately configured codex-native gateway policy.
One native meta generation, debug_max1, worker1, up to128 dispatched requests and32 evaluator invocations; external whole-process cap3600seconds. No estimated dollar/FLOP cost is reported.

Native generated Python executes in the worker process with scoped gateway credentials. In-process budgets and heldout ordering are cooperative instrumentation, not adversarial isolation. Admission requires the reviewed worker boundary; public MGSM source copies are not confidential holdout storage.

Selection uses exact observed code hashes and raw optimization arrays, never rounded CI strings. Unobserved debug-code/old-fitness mismatches at this source pin are excluded without rewriting native artifacts. Native all-archive test evaluation is replaced only by frozen-selection heldout orchestration.
